messages.text:
I reproduced the login timeout on a slow runner. The test starts looking for the workspace before the sign-in redirect finishes.

I’ll wait for the workspace heading, then repeat the test with the same delay.

The trace shows two steps in order.

1. The identity provider accepts the sign-in.
2. The workspace heading appears after the test has already timed out.

I replaced the fixed delay with a check for the heading the user sees.

```ts
await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'My Workspace' })).toBeVisible();
```

The repeated run is in progress.
